subject: Integration showcase & implementation runbook — coordinating technical demo
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@cloudhaven.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@cloudhaven.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: integration showcase request and constraints

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday — the team found the throughput / cost discussion really helpful. We'd like to schedule a technical demo that focuses on:

- Deployment options (VPC/private deployment vs hosted routing)
- Network requirements and peering/firewall expectations
- Live walkthrough of the serving runtime (KV cache, batching behavior) using our sample workload

A couple of constraints on our side:
- We need a 60–75 minute session so we can include our infra and security leads.
- Preferred window: Tue/Wed mornings (PT) the week of Sep 14.
- We must review a network diagram in advance and would like a short runbook we can share with our security team.

Attaching a high-level network diagram and the discovery notes for context. Can you confirm availability and who from Redwood would lead the demo?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Gomez
Head of Platform Engineering | Cloudhaven
[Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: cloudhaven-network.png (png)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@cloudhaven.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@cloudhaven.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: integration showcase request and constraints

Hi Alex — great to hear back. Happy to run this and pair Ben (SE) on the demo so we can get into runtime knobs and ops details. Marcus (cc'd on internal thread) will join to cover SLA/contractual items if you want that on the call.

Proposed plan (60–75 mins):
1) 10 min: Goals & architecture recap (you + our account team)
2) 30 min: Live demo with sample traffic (Ben) — show KV cache, batching, and quantization tradeoffs
3) 15 min: Network & infra checklist (me + Marcus)
4) 10–20 min: Q&A + next steps / mutual action items

Suggested slots (PT):
- Tue Sep 14: 9:30–10:45am or 11:00–12:15pm
- Wed Sep 15: 10:00–11:15am

I'll attach a draft runbook and a topline network diagram for your security review — please confirm which slot works and whether you want Marcus to cover SLA details in the session.

Attachments: runbook-draft.pdf (draft), redwood-topline-network.png

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook-draft.pdf (pdf)]

On Fri, Sep 10, 2026 at 10:22 AM Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@cloudhaven.com> wrote:
> Thanks Sofia — those slots look good.
>
> Priya and I would prefer Tue Sep 14, 11:00–12:15pm PT.
> A couple of follow-ups before the session: can your runbook include an ops checklist for data retention and audit logging? Also, can you confirm whether the demo will show the hosted API path versus a Private VPC deployment (we want to see the VPC path if possible).
>
> We will circulate an internal invite after you confirm the final attendee list.
>
> — Alex

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@cloudhaven.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@cloudhaven.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: integration showcase request and constraints

Alex — perfect. We will run the demo against a VPC/private deployment variant and also show the hosted API fallback behavior for comparison.

I will update the runbook to include:
- Data retention policy examples and how to configure retention windows
- Audit log locations and sample retention settings (CloudTrail / internal audit table)
- Network port and peering checklist with the diagram annotated

Final attendee list from our side:
- Sofia Ivanova (SE, host)
- Ben Carter (Sales Engineer, demo lead)
- Marcus Lin (Manager, Partnerships) — will join for SLA / contract Q&A (first 20 mins)

We'll also add a short section with suggested test payloads you can run during the demo.

Thanks — see you Tue Sep 14 at 11:00am PT.

Sofia

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@cloudhaven.com>, Priya Singh <priya.s@cloudhaven.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Integration showcase — Tue Sep 14 11:00–12:15 PT (calendar invite sent)

Alex / Priya — I just sent the calendar invite for Tue Sep 14 11:00–12:15 PT (blocks 75m). Calendar includes a Google Meet link and the agenda below.

Agenda (in invite):
- 11:00–11:10: Intros & goals (Sofia)
- 11:10–11:40: Demo: VPC deployment + live ops (Ben)
- 11:40–11:55: Network & retention checklist (Sofia + Marcus)
- 11:55–12:15: Q&A + next steps (all)

Attached an internal cheatsheet (redwood-sla-cheatsheet.pdf) to help answer questions on our standard SLAs and fallbacks. If you need any changes to the attendee list ahead of Tue, reply to this thread and I'll update the calendar.

Look forward to it — I'll bring the example payloads and a short failure-mode demo showing fallback routing.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-sla-cheatsheet.pdf (pdf)]
